An unofficial reference for the Axe-Fx III, FM9 and FM3. Amp, cab and effect data and Fractal Audio quotes come from the Fractal Audio Wiki, maintained by Yek. Write-ups and most gear photos come from Yek's amp and drive threads on the Fractal Audio forum (2016–2025). Descriptions of each model and some parameter notes are summarized in our own words from Fractal Audio's Blocks Guide, and firmware notes come from Fractal's release notes. Other gear photos come from manufacturers, retailers and Wikimedia Commons, credited under each photo. Gathered in November 2026. Notes for the AM4 are left out of the amp list. If your device runs older firmware, its lists can differ slightly.

Amp, pedal and cab names are trademarks of their owners and are used only to identify the gear Fractal Audio modeled.
